title: Marius discusses his leg A

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: I'm trying to make a point out of it. How do you think I got like this?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm trying to make a point out of it. How do you think I got like this?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: I was a fool! I looked up to Aengus. He's one of the greats, I offered my leg as a sort of fleshy olive branch. I just wanted him to take me under his wing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I was a fool! I looked up to Aengus. He's one of the greats, I offered my leg as a sort of fleshy olive branch. I just wanted him to take me under his wing.

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Why are you like this?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why are you like this?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Oh it's all just so simple for you isn't it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh it's all just so simple for you isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Lims for Limbs baby. It's an investment.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Lims for Limbs baby. It's an investment.

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: You'll notice your knees are still attached.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You'll notice your knees are still attached.

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: You're welcome. All part of the service.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're welcome. All part of the service.

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: How dare you. I'm very athletic usually.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How dare you. I'm very athletic usually.

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Survived? Look at my legs. Do I look like I'm surviving?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Survived? Look at my legs. Do I look like I'm surviving?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You lost a leg?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You lost a leg?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: You think I misplaced it? Left it on the train? Fuck no! This was Aengus Prince's work.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think I misplaced it? Left it on the train? Fuck no! This was Aengus Prince's work.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Aengus Prince took your leg?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Aengus Prince took your leg?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Yeah after I lent it him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah after I lent it him.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You seem to be doing ok?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You seem to be doing ok?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You seem to be doing ok?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You seem to be doing ok?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Now look closer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Now look closer.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I didn't want to make a point out of it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I didn't want to make a point out of it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I didn't want to make a point out of it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I didn't want to make a point out of it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm all ears.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm all ears.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why would you lend someone your leg? That's insane.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why would you lend someone your leg? That's insane.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why would you lend someone your leg? That's insane.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why would you lend someone your leg? That's insane.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What did he do with it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What did he do with it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What did he do with it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What did he do with it?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Guess...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Guess...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: ...Ate it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...Ate it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sold it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sold it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Recycled it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Recycled it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What did he do with it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What did he do with it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What did he do with it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What did he do with it?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: The point is, this stuff is bigger than us. You have people out here collecting human limbs for some reason. You need to watch your back.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The point is, this stuff is bigger than us. You have people out here collecting human limbs for some reason. You need to watch your back.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I see your point.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I see your point.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Look I don't really know what your point is here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look I don't really know what your point is here.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Look I don't really know what your point is here.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Look I don't really know what your point is here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If anyone asks to borrow my limbs I'll just say no.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If anyone asks to borrow my limbs I'll just say no.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If anyone asks to borrow my limbs I'll just say no.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If anyone asks to borrow my limbs I'll just say no.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fine! How much?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine! How much?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Remember before when I mentioned Aengus Prince?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Remember before when I mentioned Aengus Prince?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Well there is a rumor that he's collecting human flesh for something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well there is a rumor that he's collecting human flesh for something.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right...?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Well he could still have my leg. Could you check in with him for me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well he could still have my leg. Could you check in with him for me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why can't you do it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why can't you do it?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Can't do kid. Firstly, seeing him still makes me weak at the knees.... knee. He really is a very good chef.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can't do kid. Firstly, seeing him still makes me weak at the knees.... knee. He really is a very good chef.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So he'll leg it when you approach him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So he'll leg it when you approach him?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So he'll leg it when you approach him?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So he'll leg it when you approach him?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Ok, a little less with the leg stuff buddy. Look get my leg back and I'll give you protection for life, free of charge. Gratis.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok, a little less with the leg stuff buddy. Look get my leg back and I'll give you protection for life, free of charge. Gratis.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do it yourself!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do it yourself!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can I get a refund on the other payments?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can I get a refund on the other payments?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Can I get a refund on the other payments?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Can I get a refund on the other payments?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Maybe...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How could I forget?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How could I forget?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: How about a square 95 Lims?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How about a square 95 Lims?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure, here you go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure, here you go.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No thanks, this is extortion.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No thanks, this is extortion.

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Also while I have you. Remember what I said about Aengus Prince?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Also while I have you. Remember what I said about Aengus Prince?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Ok fine what if we worked something else out?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok fine what if we worked something else out?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Like what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well spotted.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well spotted.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If the leaderboards are so dangerous, how have you survived so long?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If the leaderboards are so dangerous, how have you survived so long?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If the leaderboards are so dangerous, how have you survived so long?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If the leaderboards are so dangerous, how have you survived so long?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sports injury?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sports injury?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened then?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened then?

nodes.speaker: Marius Mitchell
nodes.text: Secondly, I'm worried he'll just run away if he sees me and my ego wouldn't take it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Secondly, I'm worried he'll just run away if he sees me and my ego wouldn't take it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you pulling my leg?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you pulling my leg?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Secondly?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Secondly?
